Entrance Year: **Sept 2027**
Local Application Deadline: **25 Feb 2027**
Non-Local Application Deadline: **25 Feb 2027**

Academic Requirements.content:
- Applicants should have a **Bachelor's degree or equivalent academic / professional qualifications**, preferably with **at least one year of relevant work experience**.
- Applicants, normally aged **27 or above**, with **other post-secondary qualifications** and **at least 6 years of work experience** in industry, commerce or public administration, including **3 years in a managerial capacity**, will also be considered.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
All applicants must fulfil the General Entrance Requirement and **English Language Requirement** to be considered for admission.
If you are not a native speaker of English, and your Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification is awarded by institutions where the medium of instruction is not English, you are expected to provide one of the following proficiency test results **taken in a single sitting within 2 years** for fulfil the minimum English language requirement for admission purpose:
- **TOEFL Internet-based test: 80 or above**; OR
- **IELTS Academic module: Overall Band score of 6.0 or above**.
Remarks: TOEFL iBT Home Edition, the IELTS Online, IELTS indicator test, and IELTS one skill retake results will not be considered for meeting the English language Requirements for taught programmes.

Program Overview.content:
MSc in Business Analytics (MAF/MAP), Programme Code 23090, has Stream Code MAF (Full-time) and MAP (Part-time). The mode of study is Mixed Mode. Normal duration is 1.5 years (Full-time) and 2.5 years (Part-time), with 31 credits required for graduation. Programme Leader(s): **Programme Director** Prof. Xin Xu, BEcon, MPhil, PhD; **Deputy Programme Director** Dr Vincent Cho, BSc, MEngSc, PhD.
Programme Aims: This programme starts with the fundamentals of applying analytical techniques on big data for decision supports of an organisation, and progresses to in-depth studies of various application domains.
Characteristics:
1. Emphasises essential skills and knowledge of business analytics
2. Applies domains of business analytics
3. Covers theoretical knowledge and research findings of decision making using big data
4. Offers opportunities to apply theories to investigating and solving business problems
5. Focuses on the systematic training and development of skills and competence in business analytics
6. Enhances the ability to solve big data problems
7. Empowers students to achieve career potential via professional coaching and career services
Alumni describe the MSc in Business Analytics programme as a well-structured platform whose curriculum blends domain-specific business knowledge with cutting-edge data analytics tools. Students learn from faculty who bring expertise from business, academia, and technology, and who regularly share developments in AI and machine learning beyond textbook theory. The programme provides an accessible introduction to analytical techniques and a forward-looking perspective on technological evolution for those transitioning from traditional industries.
The curriculum strikes a balance between theory and practice, equipping students with skills for data-driven roles. Training in industry-standard tools such as Python, SQL, SPSS, SmartPLS, and Excel strengthens technical skills. The programme emphasises essential business analytics and problem-solving skills for translating data into meaningful insights and making informed decisions. It also focuses on experiential learning through case studies, group projects, and hands-on assignments, with faculty support and networking events connecting students with industry leaders and alumni.

Curriculum.content:
For MSc, students complete **31 credits**:
- Non-Dissertation Option: 4 Compulsory Subjects (3 credits each), 1 AIE Subject (1 credit), and 6 Elective Subjects (3 credits each).
- Dissertation Option: 4 Compulsory Subjects (3 credits each), 1 AIE Subject (1 credit), 2 Elective Subjects (3 credits each), the subject Research Methods (3 credits), and a Dissertation (9 credits).
- Students may, on completion of 4 Compulsory Subjects, 1 credit of AIE Subject and 3 Elective Subjects (**22 credits in total**), opt for the Postgraduate Diploma.
From 2025/26 Cohort onwards:
- Compulsory Subjects (4 subjects - 12 credits) (Non-Dissertation Option / Dissertation Option): MM5112 Organization and Management; MM5412 Business Intelligence and Decisions; MM5424 Management Information Systems; MM5425 Business Analytics.
- AIE Subject (1 credit) (Non-Dissertation Option / Dissertation Option): MM5T21 Academic Integrity and Business Ethics (non-chargeable).
- Non-Dissertation Option Elective Subjects (any 6 subjects - 18 credits): MM501 Research Methods; MM5203 Decision Making for Leadership; MM531 Strategic Management; MM534 Entrepreneurship; MM5413 Business Forecasting; MM5426 Business Applications of Blockchain; MM5427 Textual Analysis in Business; MM5433 Decision Analytics by Machine Learning; MM544 E-Commerce; MM5451 Technology Innovation and Management; MM5452 Seminars in Emerging Technology; MM576 Marketing Management; MM5831 Social Media Marketing; LGT5102 Models for Decision Making; LGT5105 Managing Operations Systems; LGT5113 Enterprise Resource Planning; LGT5122 Applications of Decision Making Models; MM5913 Field Study for Business Management; MM5995 MM MSc Career Workshop (0 credit).
- Dissertation Option Dissertation Subjects (total 12 credits): MM501 Research Methods (3 credits); MM594 Business Analytics Dissertation (9 credits).
- Dissertation Option Elective Subjects (any 2 subject - 6 credits): MM5203 Decision Making for Leadership; MM531 Strategic Management; MM534 Entrepreneurship; MM5413 Business Forecasting; MM5426 Business Applications of Blockchain; MM5427 Textual Analysis in Business; MM5433 Decision Analytics by Machine Learning; MM544 E-Commerce; MM5451 Technology Innovation and Management; MM5452 Seminars in Emerging Technology; MM576 Marketing Management; MM5831 Social Media Marketing; LGT5102 Models for Decision Making; LGT5105 Managing Operations Systems; LGT5113 Enterprise Resource Planning; LGT5122 Applications of Decision Making Models; MM5913 Field Study for Business Management; MM5995 MM MSc Career Workshop (0 credit).
The offering of subjects is subject to class quota availability. Students may also choose from a list of [Common Pool Electives](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/fb/study/tpg-landing/common-pool-electives/), subject to the prescriptions of programme curriculum. Programme structure, course names and content are subject to continuous review and change.
Mode of study: **Mixed-mode**. Students can pursue their studies with either a full-time study load (**9 credits or more in a semester**) or a part-time study load (**less than 9 credits in a semester**). Students normally complete the programme full-time in **1.5 years** or part-time in **2.5 years**. The programme offers a structured progression pattern. Students are encouraged to follow the pattern to benefit from the cohort-based structure. Classes are normally scheduled on weekday evenings, with some daytime classes for full-time students. Each 3-credit subject requires **39 contact hours** over a teaching semester, with one 3-hour class per week.

Multiple Applications.content:
Multiple applications are allowed for applicants seeking admission to PolyU taught postgraduate programmes. You can make another application under the same account after you have submitted one application.
You are not allowed to change your programme choice after your application has been submitted. However, you may submit another application under the same account after you have submitted one application.
The application fee for admission to taught postgraduate programmes for 2026/27 is **HK$500**, except for Master of Business Administration (MBA) and doctorate programmes of Faculty of Business. The fee is **non-refundable and non-transferrable**. You must settle the application fee upon submission of your online application, otherwise, your application will not be further processed.
If you want to accept another offer from PolyU after you have paid the tuition fees for an earlier offer, please [contact us](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/study/pg/enquiry) to transfer the fees already paid for the earlier offer to the other offer. Please remember to provide application number of both offers in your request. This arrangement only applies if both programmes lead to PolyU awards.

Conditional Admission Policy.content:
If you are given an offer or a conditional offer, you will be informed via email/SMS. To accept an offer or a conditional offer, indicate your acceptance and settle the registration fee or tuition fee before the **"last day for payment"** displayed in the Notice of Offer, and register on the programme registration date as indicated on the Notice of Offer. For a conditional offer, you need to complete the procedures for meeting the conditions stated in the Notice of Offer beforehand.
For meeting condition(s), return to the Online Notice of Offer page via [eAdmission](https://www38.polyu.edu.hk/eAdmission/index.do) to complete the procedures for "Meeting Conditions" when you have acquired the relevant qualifications on or before the **"Meet Condition Date"**.
If you are given a conditional offer, you will only receive the email notification on how to download your e-Visa after you have met the condition(s) of your admission offer.
